sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–Mexico Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT) as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019; Executive Decree No. 159 of 2019 establishing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales filing regime before the Dirección General de Ingresos; Law No. 32 of 1927 on Panamanian Sociedades Anónimas; and applicable regulations of the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros concerning customer due diligence and beneficial ownership.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access; not publicly searchable, with UBO data held in private registered-agent files and filed with the fiscal UBO registry for authorized authority access

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copy of each director, officer, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if the source country is not an Apostille Party, Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder or sponsor entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or authorized corporate administrator of the entity's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if the source country is not an Apostille Party, Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation of all legalized foreign documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian sworn public translator (traductor público autorizado)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the underlying document; translator's certification appended in Panama

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds and sponsor capital documentation (bank statement, trust deed, commitment letter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank, trust company or institutional investment manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; bank officer's notarized certification required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, directors, officers, shareholders, UBOs and SPAC sponsors against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions (1267, 1988, 1373 and successor resolutions), EU consolidated financial sanctions, the UK OFSI consolidated list, and Panamanian embargo/sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates; names must be screened continuously and results documented for at least five years after the business relationship ends. The formation agent must obtain corroborating identification and source-of-funds evidence before filing any incorporation document.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sede Electrónica (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names are recorded in Spanish or another language using the Latin alphabet; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters. The legal-form suffix 'S.A.' or an internationally recognized equivalent must appear. The name may include descriptive terms such as 'Special Purpose Acquisition Company' provided it is not misleading or identical to an existing registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ministerio / Gobierno / Estado / Presidencia / Official Government Body
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: the applicant may request one 30-day renewal before expiry by filing a written extension request and paying the registry renewal tariff. Rejection appeal: if the Registro Público rejects a name application, the registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Director General of the Registro Público within three business days of the rejection, attaching amended name alternatives and any required regulator authorization. If reconsideration is denied, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Ministerio de Gobierno within ten business days. Final judicial review may be sought before the Tercera Sala de lo Contencioso Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible at the statutory level where the licensed Panamanian registered agent provides the registered address. However, for a SPAC that will undertake a public market listing or securities issuance in Panama, the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores expects operational substance, a compliance function and accessible management; a mail-drop-only virtual address will not satisfy securities supervisory requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 30%–50% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first 18 months if the SPAC becomes a regulated securities issuer; approximately 5%–10% if the company remains a passive offshore vehicle with no Panamanian regulated activity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and phonetic similarity clearance at the Registro Público
Name reservation certificate (aviso de no uso) including official search record
Corporate incorporation filing and first copy of the bylaws at the Mercantile Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff based on par value and share structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation UBO identification, PEP/sanctions checks and source-of-funds verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel / AML compliance provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and sworn translation of four foreign due diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs / sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial/apostille tariffs plus translator's professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service for the first year
Beneficial ownership registration filing with the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (DGI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory filing fee; agent preparation included in legal fee line

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama General Corporation Law, Law 32 of 1927, as amended by Law 5 of 2008, Articles 1 through 120, together with complementary mercantile registration provisions of the Código de Comercio
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Panama Public Registry), Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública (Notarized Public Incorporation Deed) or private 'Poder' filed for registration, accompanied by the 'Ficha Registral' and incorporation certificate
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; one share must be issued and fully paid. Authorized capital is routinely fixed at USD 10,000 divided into 100 shares. For SPAC vehicles, the proceeds of the public offering must be held in a segregated trust/escrow account pending a business combination, commonly at least 90% of gross offering proceeds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby adopt and execute the Articles of Incorporation filed under Public Registry folio [—]. That the authorized capital in the amount of USD 10,000 be subscribed as set forth in the share register, and the initial Director(s) accept appointment. That the registered office is established at [address], Panama, and the law firm [Counsel] is designated as resident agent. That the following officers are elected: President, Secretary and Treasurer. That the President or any Vice President, together with the Secretary or Assistant Secretary, be and are hereby authorized to execute and deliver all securities, agreements and instruments, to open bank or trust accounts, and to take all actions necessary to complete corporate formation and qualification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Availability Check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Public Registry – Mercantile Section, via 'Registro Digital' online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application containing two alternative corporate names for the proposed SPAC vehicle; pay the name reservation fee; obtain a certificate confirming name availability; reserve the name for a statutory period.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport or official ID of the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected or deemed too similar to an existing entity, submit a fresh application with the second alternative name; no formal appeal is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Notary Public (Notario Público) in Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Counsel will prepare the Escritura Pública or private incorporation document containing the articles of incorporation, share structure, registered agent appointment, and registered office address. The subscribers must appear before the notary to execute the document, after which the notary issues a notarized certification.
required_dossiers: Drafted charter or articles of incorporation
Valid passports / identity cards of all subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies drafting errors, counsel must correct the deed and re-execute before the same notary; no additional government bureau is involved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the Panama Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized incorporation deed together with the corresponding registration forms and pay the official registration fee. The Registry examines the deed for legal compliance, issues the 'Certificado de Registro' and grants juridical personality.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation deed (original and two copies)
Notarized acceptance letters of directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an 'observación' (query), defects must be corrected within ten business days via an amendment or corrective filing; if the registration is rejected, file a reconsideration petition with the Registry under Article 24 of Law 32.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Recording of Officers, Directors, and Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Public Registry – Mercantile Section (post-registration filing unit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File notarized declarations of officer and director acceptance together with the resident agent's formal acceptance and registered office address designation; ensure the register reflects the initial board and statutory officers.
required_dossiers: Copy of the initial board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects the acceptance filings due to patent formal defects, the documents must be corrected and re-presented within five business days; no penalty is applied on first re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Municipal Operating Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipality of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the corporation's taxpayer identification number (RUC) from DGI, and thereafter apply for the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' in the district where the registered office is located. The municipality will issue a business operation notice once taxes and fees are paid.
required_dossiers: Proof of office address (lease contract or utility bill)
Copy of the company's tax ID once issued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI publishes a query regarding disagreeing with the economic activity code, file an amended application with additional evidence of the SPAC purpose; municipal issues can be resolved by presenting a revised address proof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of SPAC Trust Escrow and Operating Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian licensed bank or trust company (e.g., banks regulated by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct counsel and the board to open a segregated trust/escrow account in the name of the SPAC entity with a licensed financial institution; execute the custody and trust agreements, provide AML/KYC documents, and configure receiving SWIFT wire transfers for the IPO proceeds.
required_dossiers: AML/KYC forms and beneficial ownership certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or trust company requests further due diligence due to the SPAC nature, provide additional source-of-funds declarations and a more detailed business plan; if the bank refuses, select alternate licensed institutions with expertise in Cayman or Nevada-style SPAC structures.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV) – Securities Issuer and Public Offering Registration Directorate; complemented by the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI) for operational licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Valores y Emisores (Securities Issuer Registration) for public market activities; otherwise, the corporation must obtain a municipal 'Aviso de Operación' and an MICI business license to conduct financial holding activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MINAM) – National Environmental Authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría III – Registro Ambiental (Low Impact) for purely administrative office use; no full Environmental Impact Study required for a non-producing SPAC vehicle with no physical plant
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure financial-holding operations; if a physical office is fitted, compliance with Decree No. 561 of 2000 for atmospheric emissions, municipal wastewater discharge limits, and solid-waste handling per MINAM guidelines is mandatory

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Panama Fire Department after inspection of the registered office; structural load inspection certificates for leased premises; occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) and the Ministry of Labor for any employees

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); electronic portal: Sede Electrónica DGI (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa), supplemented by the National Customs Authority (ANA) for export controls and the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores for listed SPAC vehicles.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Panama-domiciled SPAC (Sociedad Anónima) must first complete incorporation in the Sección Mercantil of the Registro Público de Panamá and obtain its Ficha/Certificado de Registro and aviso operación municipal. The SPAC's resident legal representative must then file Formulario RUC-01 through the DGI Sede Electrónica, attaching the authenticated certificate of incorporation, the registered by-laws, the directors' resolution naming the tax representative, proof of the registered office, a notarized power of attorney, and valid identification of the ultimate beneficial owner for AML purposes. The DGI assigns the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) within approximately 5 to 8 business days and simultaneously enrolls the entity in the ISR, ITBMS, and withhold agent registries through the same single-window record. A foreign-incorporated SPAC registering in Panama as a non-domiciled taxpayer must instead obtain a non-resident RUC, appointing a Panamanian resident fiscal representative and filing apostilled incorporation documents from the home registry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope: Panamanian territorial taxation taxes an S.A. only on income derived from a Panamanian source. For the SPAC, foreign-source trust account interest, gains on disposal of shares of non-Panamanian SPAC target entities, and advisory/management fees rendered wholly offshore are outside the ISR base, provided they are not generated by capital deployed in Panama or exploitation of rights in Panamanian territory. The entity remains obliged to file the annual ISR declaration (Formulario 453) with full source-splitting disclosure and to maintain evidence of offshore fund placement. A SPAC admitted to the SEM (Multinational Corporate Headquarters) regime under Law 41 of 2007 and Law 57 of 2018 enjoys a reduced 5% effective ISR rate on qualifying Panamanian-source headquarters services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not maintain a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. Available statutory elections are: (i) opt-in to the SEM (Sede de Empresa Multinacional) tax regime by resolution of the Ministry of Commerce and Industries, obtaining a 5% effective ISR rate, ITBMS exemption on intra-group services, and dividend/distribution exemptions for qualifying structures; (ii) election of the special simplified small-taxpayer ISR regime when gross annual income does not exceed B/.200,000; (iii) election under the Fiscal Code to file consolidated annual ISR balance for fiscally linked corporations; and (iv) for a purely offshore SPAC with no Panamanian-source activity, a formal non-domiciliation position is documented to the DGI through the annual affidavit, reducing direct tax exposure to zero without a specific statutory election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Corporales Muebles y la Prestación de Servicios) — Panamanian VAT equivalent governed by Law 2 of 1998 as amended.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration threshold is zero Spanish-balboa: any person carrying out taxable transfers of goods or taxable service provisions in Panama must obtain RUC and ITBMS registration from the first transaction, with no economic turnover floor. A simplified small-taxpayer compliance regime (reduced periodic filing and simplified invoices) applies where annual gross income does not exceed B/.200,000; the SPAC trusts and IPO issuance proceeds placed in escrow are outside ITBMS because share issuance, interest on foreign deposits, and disposal of foreign shares do not constitute a taxable transfer in Panama.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Real-time electronic invoicing became phased-mandatory under DGI Resolutions 201-3523 (2020) and 202-6684 (2022): large taxpayers from 2022, medium taxpayers from 2023, and small taxpayers through 2024. Every issued invoice must be transmitted to the DGI Sede Electrónica through an authorized electronic billing provider (Proveedor de Facturación Electrónica) or the DGI free web portal; DGI validates the JSON payload and returns a fiscal authorization number and QR code that must be embedded on the invoice before delivery. API integration is mandatory for continuous issuance, while offline batch issuance is permitted for limited intermittent scenarios and must be transmitted to DGI on the next business day. SPACs issuing no Panamanian taxable sales invoices remain outside the invoice authorization requirement but must preserve source documentation evidencing the non-taxable character of their receipts.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% ITBMS applies to: (i) goods physically exported from Panamanian customs territory, supported by an approved DUA export declaration; (ii) services rendered to non-resident customers where the service is used, exploited, or consumed entirely outside Panama, as relevant for SPAC advisory, acquisition-management, or registration services billed to foreign target entities; (iii) supplies to duty-free zones and bunkering/provisioning of ships and aircraft. Dividends, interest from offshore institutions, and capital gains from disposal of non-Panamanian shares are not transfers of assets subject to ITBMS at all. The SPAC must not characterize these as zero-rated; instead it must record them as outside the ITBMS tax base in the nil return, supported by documentation of foreign-source fund custody and foreign counterparties.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUA (Documento Único de Aduanas) approved and stamped 'Exportación' by the National Customs Authority (ANA) evidencing physical exit from Panama
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the goods or, for services, a signed service agreement specifying place of performance outside Panama
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR or other transport document evidencing the physical movement of goods from Panama
Signed service contract together with attendance or performance records proving the service is supplied to and enjoyed entirely by a non-resident
Inward remittance evidence from the foreign counterparty, such as SWIFT MT103 or Panamanian bank credit advice, demonstrating payment from abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama denominates in Balboas at parity with the United States dollar, so no FX conversion risk applies; the 180-day period functions as the documentary benchmark for inward remittance substantiation. DGI and ANA cross-match DUA export records with ITBMS credits and bank inward remittances. If zero-rating is claimed without a valid DUA or offshore-service substantiation, DGI may assess the omitted 7% ITBMS, default interest at 10% per annum, a fine of B/.250 to B/.5,000 for each irregular invoice, and a 50% tax surcharge for concealment or evasion. The use of forged export or remittance documentation triggers criminal tax fraud liability under the Código Fiscal and, for SEM-licensed SPACs, revocation of the SEM tax resolution with retroactive clawback of all granted exemptions for the preceding five tax years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no conventional central bank and no monetary authority issuing legal tender. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) supervises and regulates all banking activity; the Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as the state's fiscal agent and the Comisión de Valores (Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, SMV) supervises securities markets. Foreign exchange policy is effectively subsumed by the de jure dollarization statute under which the United States dollar is full legal tender, with SBP and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) jointly enforcing sanctions, AML/CFT, and payment-system rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Unrestricted full convertibility. Panama imposes no exchange controls on current or capital account transactions; profit remittances, dividends, capital repatriation, and trust disbursements may be effected freely in USD without Central Bank authorization. The Balboa remains a nominal 1:1 USD coin-fraction unit and has no independent exchange rate. Tax standing charges under the territorial regime and beneficial-ownership filings with the Dirección de Administración de Fondos y Fideicomisos (DAFI) are the only procedural preconditions to outward remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Panama does not impose statutory timelines or mandatory conversion ratios for the surrender of export proceeds or any other foreign-currency receipts. Entities may retain USD and freely hold multi-currency accounts with SBP-licensed banks; there is no repatriation window, no central-bank clearing obligation, and no export-invoice registration requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (SPAC Trust) and Operational Current Account
Trust Escrow / Managed Custody Account and Operational Account
Operational Current Account and Clearing Sub-Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for this transaction profile. Panama's Fintech Innovation Regime (Law 26 of February 17, 2022) permits sandbox licensing for electronic money and payment-system innovators, but offshore digital EMIs (EU, UK, or BVI-licensed) cannot open settlement accounts, access the local automated clearing house (Cámara de Compensación), or serve as the depositary for SPAC trust proceeds without a full license from the SBP or an authorized Panama bank as correspondent. Given the SPAC's mandatory trust-escrow rail and SWIFT wire settlement, an onshore SBP-licensed bank with corporate trust powers is legally required; an offshore EMI may at most execute pass-through treasury payments via that bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for at least one director, the ultimate beneficial owners, and the mandated signatories at a notarized board session in Panama (Panamanian Civil Code and Ley 47 de 2013 corporate formalism require in-person notarial execution of the Opening Resolution). Remote onboarding is not available to medium-risk-enhanced legal persons such as blank-check/SPAC vehicles. The compliance officer must conduct an in-person due-diligence interview with the economic owner and one independent director; if directors are non-resident, a Panamanian attorney-in-fact with a notarized and apostilled power of attorney must be appointed and physically appear.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Blank-check or shell profile with no historical operating revenue and no operational substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SMV-registered public offering prospectus; escrow trust agreement with an SBP-licensed qualified trustee; underwriting or placement agency agreement; board resolution confirming the 24-36 month business-combination deadline; certified share register showing full-paid sponsor founder equity; and a functional corporate office lease or administration agreement in Panama.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source and provenance of seed capital and sponsor contributions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements or tax returns of each sponsor shareholder covering a two-year look-back; bank reference letters and supporting wire statements for seed deposits; accredited investor status attestations; and a source-of-wealth narrative letter from each sponsor accompanied by notarized signature certification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity, including historical bearer-share concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DAFI (Registry of Final Beneficial Owners) authenticated filing; certificate of cancellation and conversion of all bearer shares into registered shares under Law 23 of 2015; certified list of directors, officers, and ultimate beneficial owners; and notarized declarations of no nominee arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wiring to high-risk or sanctioned target jurisdictions at business-combination closing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty AML/KYC pack for the acquisition target; sanctions-screening and OFAC/UN consolidated-list results; funds-flow memorandum detailing each outbound MT103; legal opinion on the target's corporate existence; and the executed merger or acquisition agreement with escrow-release conditions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-residency ambiguity of a Panamanian territorial-tax vehicle used for a US or international SPAC listing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DGI tax identification certificate and territorial-tax status letter; articles of incorporation showing the corporate purpose and non-residency of sponsoring shareholders; FATCA/CRS self-certifications and automatic-exchange registration from the GAFI system; and an external tax-opinion confirming no permanent establishment in Panama outside the securities underwriting.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound sponsor seed capital and IPO trust subscription proceeds must enter via SWIFT wire into a segregated trust escrow account held at an SBP-licensed qualified trustee bank in Panama. Wires must carry the purpose description 'Capital Contribution for SPAC Trust' or the SWIFT transfer-of-funds category corresponding to securities subscription, must identify the ultimate remitter and beneficial owner in the remitter information field, and must be preceded by the signed subscription agreement, the SMV-registered prospectus, and the escrow trust agreement. The trustee verifies each credit against the capitalization schedule and runs OFAC, UN, EU, and SBP-consolidated watchlist screening on both the remitter and the beneficiary before accepting funds; any wire lacking a valid securities-public-offering nexus is rejected back to the remitting institution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Business-combination and acquisition closings settle via SWIFT MT103 single-beneficiary wires, with the SPAC trustee releasing trust funds only against a trust certificate and closing memorandum jointly executed by the SPAC board and the trustee. Where the acquisition includes trade assets, inventory, or commercial consideration, a commercial letter of credit (documentary LC, ICC UCP 600) opened by the Panamanian bank on the SPAC's account is the permitted rail for commodity or goods-linked tranches. For publicly-listed target consideration, settlement is effected through an SMV-registered intermediary using DTC or Euroclear instructions rather than direct bank transfer. Domestic ACH and real-time local rails are prohibited for trust assets and must not be used for any outbound SPAC disbursement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC outright forward contracts (USD vs. target-company functional currency) booked with SBP-licensed international banks under ISDA 2002 with the Panamanian SA as the dealing entity
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-convertible target currencies (e.g., RMB, COP, ARS) executed offshore through the Panamanian bank's overseas treasury desk
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus target currency) with SBP-qualified swap dealers for acquisition and post-merger balance-sheet hedging
Vanilla USD call/put options on the target currency with a maturity not exceeding the SPAC business-combination deadline

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual franchise tax payment (Tasa Única / Flat Annual Corporate Tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due between January 1 and March 31 of each calendar year; no anniversary-based extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus DGI default interest; denial of good-standing and paz y salvo certificates; after repeated non-payment, DGI may apply for administrative strike-off in the Registro Público

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income tax return (Declaración Jurada Anual de ISR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal period, due by March 31 of the following year; a maximum two-month extension may be requested electronically before the original deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of B/.50 to B/.200 for nil returns and/or 10% of tax due plus interest; suspension of the taxpayer identification number (RUC) and coercive collection; prolonged delinquency supports administrative strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation (Actualización del Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the calendar month corresponding to the entity's corporate anniversary; not linked to the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Panama's beneficial ownership law, prohibition on issuing good-standing certificates, and blocking of corporate registry filings until compliance; persistent breach can trigger registry strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: DGI Resolution 201-1678 of 2013 requires audited financial statements where annual gross Panama-sourced income exceeded B/.250,000, where the entity is a licensed financial/fiduciary intermediary, or where DGI specifically so requires. A non-operating SPAC holding a trust/escrow account and with nil Panama-source revenue is normally subject only to the filing of unaudited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as issued by the IASB and adopted by Panama's Colegio de Contadores Públicos; micro and small entities below B/.250,000 gross income may use local simplified standards/PCGA in the financial-statement note filed with DGI.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panama requires each corporation to maintain a full beneficial-ownership declaration on file with the registered agent and to update the DGI beneficial-owners registry annually during the anniversary month; the update identifies direct and indirect owners, ultimate natural persons, and any SPAC sponsor or trust purpose. The shareholder ledger must be presented to DGI upon request, and no separate annual shareholder return is accepted as a substitute.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Minutes Book – Shareholders' Meeting (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minutes Book – Board of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 – USD 1,500 per year for registered agent, office, and compliance monitoring (excluding DGI fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 7,500 per year for a certified audit of a non-operating SPAC holding vehicle; if no audit threshold is triggered, USD 350 – USD 1,200 for a compilation or review of financial statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta, ISR) on net taxable income derived from Panamanian-source activities
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: foreign-source income (e.g., SPAC trust interest earned on U.S. Treasury bills) is excluded from the Panamanian tax base, yielding a 0% effective rate on such proceeds. Preferential 5% dividend withholding rate applies to distributions made to Panamanian-resident corporate shareholders (10% for non-residents and resident individuals). Special regimes (e.g., SEM Law 41/2007, Colon Free Zone) are available only under separate licensing and are generally inapplicable to a blank-check acquisition vehicle.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 2 (Informe de Rentas - Annual Income Tax Return) filed via the DGI electronic portal (Oficina Virtual del Contribuyente / e-Tax 2.0 at www.dgi.gob.pa); payment remitted through Banco Nacional de Panama or authorized banking channels using the RUC-linked payment voucher.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year corporations the general statutory deadline is March 15, but the DGI applies a staggered calendar based on the RUC last digit extending the filing window into April/May. 'Gran Contribuyente' (large taxpayer) status mandates exclusive e-filing and a potential acceleration of deadlines.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number of the Panama S.A. and check digit, which must match the Mercantile Registry inscription and the resident agent's records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panamanian RUC issued to the S.A. The non-resident beneficial owners are not identified on this box; the local resident agent (agente residente) holds the underlying ownership documentation and power of attorney for filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year covered by the return (e.g., 01-01-2024 to 12-31-2024) and confirmation of the economic activity code (CIIU/ISIC 6499).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-calendar fiscal year may be adopted only with prior DGI authorization; non-resident SPACs generally remain on the calendar year to align with the U.S. trust reporting cycle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross receipts of the entity for the period, including interest income, sponsor fees, and any merger or advisory income, without deduction of costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source and exempt income must be included in gross totals for information traceability; the SPAC's trust interest from foreign securities is reported here but excluded in the subsequent exempt-income box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Casilla 4 - Ingresos Exentos y de Fuente Extranjera
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income excluded from Panamanian tax under the territoriality principle, notably interest derived from foreign treasury instruments held by the SPAC trust/escrow account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach supporting investment statements from the U.S. trustee showing the trust instruments are issued and serviced outside Panama. Failure to substantiate this position may cause the DGI to reclassify the income as Panamanian-source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deducting allowable costs and expenses attributable to Panamanian-source activity. A pure-deal SPAC normally presents a small or nil taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses directly attributable to Panamanian-source income may be deducted; general SPAC formation costs and SEC filing fees of the foreign listing are not allocable to Panamanian taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resulting corporate income tax at 25% of the taxable net income declared in Casilla 5.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no Panamanian-source income exists, enter zero. A nil return is still mandatory and must be accompanied by the independent auditor's report where the S.A. exceeds the DGI asset/revenue threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advanced tax payments (anticipos, including the 2% minimum advance on gross revenue) and any withholding taxes previously credited to the taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that the annual 'anticipo' computed under Código Fiscal Article 733 has been paid via monthly/quarterly installments; uncredited advances generate refund rights but also DGI audit triggers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Casilla 8 - Impuesto a Pagar / Saldo a Favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net position: tax due after credits or refundable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments must be settled in Balboas (1:1 USD). Refunds require a full electronic exposure of bank accounts and supporting foreign-trust documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supplementary schedule disclosing transactions with foreign related parties, required irrespective of the taxable base where such transactions exist.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident sponsors providing management or advisory services to the SPAC must disclose those payments and justify arm's-length fees; the annex is filed with the annual return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment attracts a surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus default interest of 1% per month (or fractional month) on the unpaid principal; additional discretionary fines of B/.50 to B/.5,000 may be imposed for non-filing or for filing with incorrect data. Persistent non-filing triggers forced assessment (determinación de oficio), asset embargo, and travel restrictions on the responsible officer.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders and resident individuals; 5% when the recipient is a Panamanian-resident legal entity. Distributions of paid-in capital (strict SPAC principal redemption) are not dividends if the board expressly resolves a capital reduction and records it with the Mercantile Registry before payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTA network is narrow (treaties in force or ratified with Spain, South Korea, Mexico, Singapore, UAE, Qatar, Barbados; several signed treaties such as Portugal, France, Luxembourg and the Netherlands are not yet fully in force). Protocol: (1) the non-resident shareholder obtains a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the competent authority of its jurisdiction; (2) the Panamanian paying company submits the TRC to the DGI with a treaty-relief application (Solicitud de Aplicación de Beneficio de Convenio) prior to or alongside the dividend payment; (3) DGI validates the application and authorizes the reduced rate at source; amounts withheld above the treaty rate are recoverable via a formal refund claim. In practice, treaty dividends rarely drop below 5% and the application process is audit-intensive for an offshore SPAC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 12.5% statutory withholding on Panamanian-source license, trademark, patent, or know-how fees paid to non-residents; treaty rates under active DTAs generally range from 5% to 10%. Interest: 6% statutory withholding on Panamanian-source interest paid to non-residents (e.g., sponsor loans or PIPE convertible notes); applicable treaty limits typically hold the rate at 5% to 6%. For a SPAC, interest on escrowed U.S. securities is foreign-source and should not be subjected to Panamanian withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File / Master File documentation (Informe de Precios de Transferencia) applies where annual gross income exceeds B/.2,500,000 and the taxpayer engaged in cross-border related-party transactions; a related-party annex is required at lower thresholds. SPACs entering sponsor management agreements, merger-consulting fees, or deferred underwriting arrangements with foreign affiliates must document those transactions even when the taxable base is nil.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) derive from Law 70 of 2019 and Executive Decree No. 43 of 2020. A tax-resident S.A. earning foreign-source income from covered activities—of which investment holding is expressly included—must demonstrate adequate substance in Panama: physical office space, locally engaged and competent staff, board meetings and management decisions held in Panama, and complete accounting records kept in-country. A SPAC relying on the territorial exemption for foreign trust interest is squarely within the ESR review scope; the trust's genuine third-party character and the presence of an independent Panamanian director materially strengthen the substance file. The annual ESR informative return must be filed with the DGI regardless of tax position.
